WITH signups AS (
            SELECT
                user_id,
                MIN(DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamp)) AS cohort_date
            FROM events
            WHERE timestamp >= '2023-01-01 00:00:00' AND timestamp <= '2024-12-31 23:59:59'
            GROUP BY user_id
        ),
        user_activity AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                user_id,
                DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamp) AS activity_date
            FROM events
            
        ),
        cohort_activity AS (
            SELECT
                s.user_id,
                s.cohort_date,
                FLOOR((DATE_DIFF('day', s.cohort_date, a.activity_date)) / 1) AS unit_since_signup
            FROM signups s
            LEFT JOIN user_activity a ON s.user_id = a.user_id
            WHERE a.activity_date >= s.cohort_date
        ),
        cohort_sizes AS (
            SELECT
                cohort_date,
                COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cohort_size
            FROM signups
            GROUP BY cohort_date
        ),
        retention_counts AS (
            SELECT
                ca.cohort_date,
                ca.unit_since_signup,
                COUNT(DISTINCT ca.user_id) AS returning_users
            FROM cohort_activity ca
            JOIN cohort_sizes cs ON ca.cohort_date = cs.cohort_date
            GROUP BY ca.cohort_date, ca.unit_since_signup
        )
        SELECT
            cs.cohort_date,
            cs.cohort_size,
            rc.unit_since_signup,
            rc.returning_users
        FROM cohort_sizes cs
        LEFT JOIN retention_counts rc ON cs.cohort_date = rc.cohort_date
        ORDER BY cs.cohort_date DESC, rc.unit_since_signup ASC
